title: Vague on Purpose
description: A careless login error message can leak which emails are registered, handing an attacker a free account-enumeration tool. Confirm SwiftCargo's login endpoint refuses to make that distinction.
successCondition: POST /api/auth/login with an email that was never registered returns 401 with the exact same error.code (UNAUTHORIZED) and message text as POST /api/auth/login with a registered email but the wrong password.
hints: Register one real account first so you have a known-good email to pair with a deliberately wrong password.
Diff the two 401 response bodies field by field — the message string itself, not just the status code, must match.
